stories.title: 'Don't F with his time': Inside Curt Cignetti's uber-efficient practice at Indiana
stories.summary: Cignetti and his coaches don't waste a second, finishing an hour sooner than most CFB programs.

stories.title: Tiger's license suspended 5 years after plea deal
stories.summary: Tiger Woods had his driver's license suspended five years Wednesday after striking a plea deal in his DUI case.

stories.title: Carr, Manning top packed Heisman odds boards
stories.summary: Notre Dame quarterback CJ Carr and Texas quarterback Arch Manning are the favorites to win the Heisman Trophy, but the odds at sportsbooks suggest it's a wide-open race.

stories.title: Vikings GM expects McCarthy on Week 1 roster
stories.summary: Vikings general manager Nolan Teasley said Wednesday he expects quarterback J.J. McCarthy to be a part of the team when the regular season begins.

stories.title: Judge upholds eligibility for Missouri's Webb
stories.summary: A judge has upheld a temporary restraining order allowing Missouri defensive tackle Sterling Webb a fifth year of eligibility.
